# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

**Champion retained** — Last candidate shows better lockbox minimum but unacceptable tuning minimum (0.05) and worse drawdown profile.

## Observations

1. **52 loops** in 5.5 hours = ~6.3 min/iteration (healthy pace)
2. **No inconclusive** candidates — clean state
3. **Champion stable** at v5 — system may be approaching local optimum
4. **Candidate name** (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) suggests macro-exposure experiments ongoing

## Ready to Continue

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Execute when ready. Will monitor for:
- Tuning min degradation below 0.30
- MDD breaches beyond -12%
- Champion promotion opportunities
